description: Parstoday describes same-day demonstrations across seven Kabul-province districts and an aggregate qualitative turnout but does not establish a common organizer or per-site attendance. A single multi-site event versus distinct local gatherings remains unresolved.
required_followup: Find contemporary evidence of organizer, coordination and site-level turnout before deciding whether to split or aggregate the candidate.

description: The Feb. 4 report does not state when the district demonstrations dispersed or ended.
required_followup: Seek contemporaneous follow-up documenting physical departure or dissolution; do not infer a one-day end from the event date.

description: No event-specific Afghan state response is reported for the Feb. 4 demonstrations; all seven dimensions remain unknown.
required_followup: Find direct accounts of reception, arrests, beatings, dispersal, explicit ignoring, killings or firearm shootings attributable to this gathering.

description: The opened body attributes the article to Radio Dari citing Shafaqna Afghanistan. The full written origin and whether the reporting was republished are not established; there is no independent confirmation.
required_followup: Trace the cited Shafaqna item or find a separate contemporaneous original report; preserve source-level attribution.

description: The Feb. 8 Herat rally is dated, but Salam Times does not establish physical end.
required_followup: Seek physical closure evidence; do not use publication date or last reported speech as an end.

description: The opened Salam Times report does not establish any Afghan state response to the Feb. 8 rally.
required_followup: Find event-specific evidence for each response dimension; keep silent dimensions unknown.

description: Attendance and demands for the Feb. 8 Herat rally rely on one Salam Times report with generic “Omar” byline and no external written agency identified.
required_followup: Seek a distinct contemporary account or source and verify whether any apparent report shares written origin.

description: Afghanistan Times documents a bus-driver highway action but reports no driver or assembled-participant count; passenger impacts do not establish attendance of 50.
required_followup: Find a contemporaneous count of drivers or people physically assembled at the blockade.

description: The Kabul–Kandahar bus-driver report says the action had lasted five days and begun the prior week but does not fix exact onset or physical end.
required_followup: Find dated start/closure reporting; do not convert the reported duration into an exact date or assume the action ended at publication.

description: The report mentions an Interior Ministry investigation statement/promise but does not establish whether drivers were actually received or negotiated with; arrests, beatings, dispersal, ignoring, killings and shootings are also unreported.
required_followup: Seek event-specific evidence for reception/negotiation and each other state-response dimension.

description: The opened Kabul–Kandahar bus-driver action and search-only Feb. land-transport/trucker strike leads (including a reported call-off) may be related or separate; work stoppage/blockade reports do not establish an identical physical episode.
required_followup: Compare exact locations, participants, dates and organizers in independently accessible accounts before merging or treating the sector leads as one episode.

description: KabulNow’s word “tens” for the Feb. 16 Herat teachers’ march does not provide a clear minimum of 50; 8am reports no count. The inaccessible Pajhwok headline is not used as verified attendance.
required_followup: Find a direct, reliable count for the assembled teachers; do not infer a threshold from payroll or teacher workforce totals.

description: The Feb. 16 march date is supported, but the opened reports do not state when the physical gathering ended.
required_followup: Seek a contemporaneous account of departure/dissolution; the governor-office route or deadline does not establish closure.

description: The governor’s reported promise to relay teachers’ concerns and delivery of a participant resolution do not establish actual state reception/negotiation; no other state response dimension is established.
required_followup: Seek direct evidence of a hearing/negotiation and event-specific arrest, beating, dispersal, ignore, killing or shooting evidence.

description: S007 and S009 appear to report the same Herat teachers’ rally, but independent written origin is unresolved. S007 discloses Etilaatroz/KabulNow branding and an unopened Etilaat Roz same-topic lead exists; no exact shared body was established. Do not infer copied origin from event similarity or independence from publisher names.
required_followup: Review original written reports and any explicit agency/republication indicators when accessible; retain S007’s own opened-body facts and do not make an independence claim.

description: Pajhwok S008 exposed its headline, byline, date, a truncated lead and an explicit login/subscription gate; the full body was not read. S010 Etilaat Roz remains search-only and is not treated as an alternate copy.
required_followup: Respect the Pajhwok gate; use only independently accessible original reporting if found. Do not request known copies or use the headline as body evidence.

description: The Feb. 16 Herat teachers’ march is a new physical action, but relation to January salary-equality candidates AFG202101-E002, E003 and E005 is unresolved. Shared demand alone does not establish a continuous or nationally coordinated episode.
required_followup: Compare dates, organizers, coordination and documented physical continuity in both monthly dossiers; keep the February rally separate pending evidence.

description: The TOLOnews S018 exact page returned HTTP 403 before any article body was received. The search excerpt about a northern route closure over a child’s release remains unverified; publisher denial prohibits retry, bypass and known-copy requests.
required_followup: Do not retry or seek a copied body. Use only genuinely separate accessible reporting if a future review identifies a distinct original source; otherwise retain occurrence and event details unknown.

description: The S018 search excerpt does not establish whether the route closure involved a public gathering, participant count, physical action date, organizer, state target or response; no candidate is created from the snippet.
required_followup: Do not infer a qualifying assembly from a blockade/closure. Any independent evidence must establish physical gathering, month ownership, state demand and turnout.

description: The opened Salam Watandar body establishes an initial public gathering outside Sarai Shahzada when the nationwide money-changers’ strike began and further protest gatherings in Kabul and some provinces on Feb. 20, but reports no participant counts or site list. Opened Parstoday S014 reports the nationwide work stoppage and Central Bank licensing grievance but no public gathering or attendance; its 430 licenses and five company conversions are not turnout. Other leads remain search-only or publisher-blocked.
required_followup: Find reliable counts and precise sites for the S003 gatherings; determine whether S014’s strike report refers to the same physical episode. Do not request the blocked Al-Araby body or infer attendance from closed businesses, licenses or work stoppage.

description: Search-only trucker/transport leads report strike/call-off and price impact but do not provide evidence of a >=50 public assembly; those impact measures are not participant counts.
required_followup: Identify whether truckers assembled publicly, when, where and how many attended before creating an event candidate. No further Pajhwok body request was made after its paywall gate.

description: Dari and Pashto search terms and Dari bodies were used, but no independent human review of the translations/interpretations was completed; some discovery leads remain unread.
required_followup: Obtain an independent Dari-language review of the two opened source interpretations before any final coding decision.

description: The current official Mass Mobilization baseline, full universe and supplemental coding procedure/reuse conditions remain unverified; assignment retains pending_official_baseline.
required_followup: Coordinator must verify official latest dataset bytes, codebook, supplemental procedure, universe and permitted use before any official compatibility determination, mapping, integration or contribution; provisional consolidation and working exports may continue under the project protocol.

description: This is a bounded open-web sweep of 12 logged searches, not LexisNexis or a systematic newspaper-archive census. Search engines surfaced many out-of-period results and do not establish exhaustive February coverage or absence.
required_followup: A later review may add local newspaper, regional and archive coverage under the fixed cutoff; preserve open-web/method limits and never claim absence from query volume.

description: Coverage is uneven across provinces and sectors despite weekly sweeps plus regional, boundary, wage, transport, money-changer, security-policy, women’s-rights, land, utility and price terms. S014 is now opened but documents only the money-changer work stoppage, not an assembly; other unresolved leads remain unopened, search-only or blocked.
required_followup: Continue bounded source-led searches across provinces and local-language outlets; verify dates/physical actions in original accessible documents and do not treat gaps as evidence of no events.

description: January Behsud Jan. 29/31 actions have unresolved episode boundaries; later visits, inquiry findings, armed confrontation and the Feb. 8 police suspension are not evidence of a new February public assembly or its physical end. No January-onset continuation is added without a February physical action.
required_followup: Continue Jan./Feb./March boundary review only if dated evidence of physical action in February is found; separate subsequent administrative/follow-up developments from public assembly.

description: Salam Watandar S003 dates the money-changer strike as beginning “16 days” before Feb. 21 and also gives “18 Dalw/Bahman”; the exact Gregorian day remains unresolved. Parstoday S014 is dated Feb. 6 / 18 Dalw 1399 and says nationwide work stopped from Saturday, but does not establish a public gathering or its exact onset. The body separately places further S003 gatherings on Feb. 20.
required_followup: Resolve the relative and Afghan-calendar clues against a reliable calendar/source before assigning an exact assembly day; retain month precision unless direct evidence dates the physical gathering.

description: An initial Sarai Shahzada gathering and Feb. 20 protest gatherings in Kabul and some provinces occurred during a nationwide strike, but the number/sites/organizers of those assemblies and their episode relationship are not established. Parstoday S014 confirms only work-stoppage/policy context and reports no assembly; the strike’s national scale is not proof of a single nationwide public-assembly event.
required_followup: Compare date, organizer, participant and site evidence across accessible original accounts before merging or splitting gatherings.

description: Salam Watandar S003 attributes the strike-end announcement to presidential deputy spokesperson Dawa Khan Menapal and his tweet. Parstoday S014 is a separate Feb. 6 report whose page byline says Pars Today while its body credits a Radio Dari correspondent. No exact shared written body or editorial relationship with S003 is established; do not claim independent corroboration or infer copied origin from an unknown relationship.
required_followup: If a later review finds an exact written-source match or explicit republication credit, record it; otherwise retain the actual byline/attribution evidence and leave independence open.
